decisions.rationale: "tumor" is retained as a disease term (not excluded as a general term) and here modifies the noun phrase "chromosome translocation" in "tumor-associated chromosome translocation," so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Modifiers); What NOT to Annotate 4 (cancer and tumor are retained)

decisions.rationale: The span contains two separate disease mentions, "Ewing sarcoma" (a specific disease) and "related neuroectodermal tumors" (a family of tumors), joined by "and" in one contiguous string, so it is a Composite Mention.

decisions.rationale: "Ewing tumors" refers to tumors of the Ewing type, i.e., Ewing sarcoma, which has one specific definition without further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease rather than a general term.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What NOT to Annotate 4 (cancer and tumor are retained)
